device.description: 12-bit 6 MSPS 4-input simultaneous-sampling pipeline ADC with parallel uC/DSP interface
device.note: ths1207.pdf (SLAS284A) p.1 pinout, p.2 recommended operating conditions, p.4 timing requirements, p.5 terminal functions, p.14 conversion clock, p.17 output formats (Tables 2-5), p.18-21 control registers (Tables 6-11), p.22-25 bus timing (Figures 31-35)

registers.name: CR0
registers.note: p.19 Table 8: control register 0, reset 020h (DIFF0 = 1); bit 1 reserved

registers.name: CR1
registers.note: p.21 Table 11: control register 1, reset 030h (reserved bits 4 and 5 reset to 1, always write 0)

commands.name: Write CR1 with RESET = 1
commands.note: p.21 Table 11: writing 1 to CR1 bit 0 resets the device and sets CR0 and CR1 to their reset values (0x401 in the configuration flow)

commands.name: Write CR1 with RBACK = 1 (debug mode)
commands.note: p.21 Table 11: debug mode; the first read after RBACK is set returns CR0, the second CR1

commands.name: Write control register 1
commands.note: RA1 = 0, RA0 = 1 on D11/D10, register value on D9-D0 (control register addressing table)

commands.name: Write control register 0
commands.note: RA1 = 0, RA0 = 0 on D11/D10, register value on D9-D0 (control register addressing table)

pages: p.1 (pinout), p.2 (ROC), p.4 (timing requirements), p.5 (terminal functions), p.14-16 (conversion), p.17 (output formats), p.18-21 (control registers), p.22-25 (bus timing)
notModeled: analog inputs, channel / differential / autoscan selection (CR0 bits 3-7), test voltages (CR0 TEST), internal/external reference and offset calibration (CR1 OFFSET) are stored only; the result is the 0 V code
CS1 (active-high chip select) is not modeled: tie it high; only CS0 (active low) selects the part

R/W mode (CR1 bit 6 = 1: WR (R/W) becomes a combined R/W input and RD is disabled) is not modeled: the bus stays in RD/WR mode (the CR1 reset value). The power-on state of RD/WR is unknown per the datasheet; the first access has to be a write
the RESET bit holds the device in reset until 0 is written to it; the model resets the registers when the write ends (RESET then reads 0)
debug read-back: the upper bits D11/D10 of the read-back words are taken from the register tables (CR0: 00, CR1: 01); after the first (CR0) read every further read returns CR1 until RBACK is cleared
CR0 PD (power down) is stored only; conversions continue in the model
pipeline latency (5 CONV_CLK cycles) and the CONV_CLK-to-read setup times are not modeled

codeFormat: CR1 BIN/2s = 0 two's complement (0 V differential = 000h), 1 binary (0 V differential = 800h, written "offset"); the power-on input is the differential channel AINP-AINM (CR0 DIFF0 = 1). A single-ended input at 0 V is below VREFM and reads 000h binary / 800h two's complement
SYNC output (active low when channel-1 data is on the bus in multichannel operation; disabled in single-channel mode) is not driven; CR1 SRST (sync generator reset) is stored only
every CONV_CLK falling edge starts a conversion (continuous mode only, 0.1-6 MHz); not timed (time 0), each read returns the 0 V code
variants: THS1207C (0-70 C) and THS1207I (-40-85 C) share the datasheet
